# www.bookfarmvilla.com

> BookFarmVilla connects people planning weddings and events with farmhouses, villas, and wedding lawns for booking, plus event vendors including caterers, photographers, DJs, and decorators, across India. Discovery is free — no online payment is required; visitors browse listings and request a callback to speak with a booking expert.

## Home

- [BookFarmVilla | Farmhouses, Villas & Wedding Venues](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/): Browse farmhouses, villas, and wedding lawns available for booking, plus request a callback to speak with a booking expert — no online payment required.

## Farmhouses

- [Farmhouses for Rent | BookFarmVilla](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/properties?type=FARMHOUSE): Farmhouses for day outings, parties, and weekend stays, with guest capacity, amenities, and starting price shown on each listing. Request a callback to check availability.

## Villas

- [Villas for Booking | BookFarmVilla](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/properties?type=VILLA): Private villas for celebrations, corporate offsites, and short stays, with guest capacity, amenities, and starting price shown on each listing. Request a callback to check availability.

## Wedding Lawns

- [Wedding Lawns & Venues | BookFarmVilla](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/properties?type=WEDDING_LAWN): Open-air wedding lawns and event venues sized for ceremonies and receptions, with guest capacity, amenities, and starting price shown on each listing. Request a callback to check availability.

## Vendors

- [Event Vendors Directory | BookFarmVilla](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/vendors): Vendors and service providers for weddings and events, organized by category: caterers, photographers, DJs, decorators, makeup artists, and other event services.
- [Catering Services | BookFarmVilla](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/vendors?category=CATERER): Caterers for weddings and events, listed by location and service type. Request a callback to get a quote.
- [Wedding & Event Photographers | BookFarmVilla](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/vendors?category=PHOTOGRAPHER): Photographers and photography studios for weddings and events, covering candid, cinematic, drone, and pre-wedding shoots. Request a callback to get a quote.
- [DJ & Entertainment | BookFarmVilla](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/vendors?category=DJ): DJs and entertainment providers for weddings and events. Request a callback to get a quote.
- [Decoration Services | BookFarmVilla](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/vendors?category=DECORATOR): Decorators for weddings and events, covering stage, floral, and venue decor. Request a callback to get a quote.
- [Other Event Services | BookFarmVilla](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/vendors?category=OTHER_SERVICES): Additional event service providers, including makeup artists and other specialists, for weddings and events. Request a callback to get a quote.

## About

- [About Us | BookFarmVilla](https://www.bookfarmvilla.com/about): How BookFarmVilla works — a free venue and vendor discovery platform connecting event planners with farmhouses, villas, wedding lawns, and vendors through a callback request, without online payment.
